follow_up.span: A total of 8246 patients underwent randomization and were followed for a mean of 3.5 years.

served_mismatch: No substantive numerical mismatch: the served CI 0.54–0.90 rounds the registry CI 0.539–0.902. However, fulltext_verified provenance is unsupported by this packet; the cited PMID 33026243 abstract is not held. Binding instead uses registry outcome 13.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Entry criteria specify type 2 diabetes with established cardiovascular disease; age is at least 40. Baseline HF is not required, although actual enrollment with and without HF is not explicitly reported.

notes: Registry spans are accepted because held abstracts lack the standalone HHF estimate. Outcome 13 reports pooled ertugliflozin versus placebo in all randomized participants, using the on-study approach, with a registry time frame up to approximately 6 years. The abstract reports actual mean trial follow-up. Registry eligibility excludes NYHA IV heart failure.
